regressionAggregation: Candidate/reference: medians of complete wall and original-owner inclusive wait4 CPU; observed maxima of complete wall and sampled simultaneous complete-tree RSS. All valid comparable cells participate, including nonwinning cells. Missing/noncomparable/failed observations never fabricate numeric ratios.
samplingPolicy: Eight independent paired launches per cell. Alternate first engine by pair index and rotate scenario order. Retain all attempts. No selective reruns or removal. An external interruption invalidates the entire affected run; retain its original evidence. No serving process or database seed may be prepared outside the complete clock. Identical disclosed one-time package/application compilation may be outside.
confidencePolicy: Point wins use median paired ratio >= 2; confirmed wins also require per-cell 95% paired confidence lower bound >= 2. Count each distinct scenario once, requiring both resource cells. At least five of nine confirmed scenarios and at least two of three application wins. No simultaneous 95% majority-confidence claim.
resourceCoveragePolicy: Same declared whole host and worker limits for both engines, serial executions, no competing test/build jobs. Record background confounds. Include all test-owned backend/database/mail work. Missing required coverage or sampled tree RSS above 8 GiB makes a cell noncomparable; never silently exclude it. Sampled bounds are not OS-enforced limits; retain short-lived/reparented-process limitations. CPU uses the original owner terminal wait4 receipt exactly once after raw launch, identity and reap reconstruction. Sampled CPU is diagnostic only. RSS includes non-atomic boundary observations; unsampled short-lived memory remains explicit.
sealingRequirements: Exact dynamically admitted original test inventories/callback hashes and application policies
Reviewed complete-clock and resource collectors, including owned database and mail coverage
Behavior/lifecycle and independent Playwright 1.60 baseline admission
Premeasurement root approval and collector ordering evidence
